glosses: error (a faulty process of thought that leads to conclusions out of agreement with reality)
error (the resulting thought, conception, assumption, belief, determination, etc., of a flawed thought process)
error (the condition of one who has made and maintains such incorrect conclusions)

examples.text: Vous devez apprendre de vos erreurs.
examples.en: You must learn from your mistakes.

examples.text: Tu dois apprendre de tes erreurs.
examples.en: You must learn from your mistakes.
